function left() {}
function right() {}
function nested() {}
true && (left.label = 'and');
false || (right.label = 'or');
(true && true) && (nested.label = 'nested');
console.log(left.label, right.label, nested.label);

function optional<const T extends string[] | undefined>(value: T): T {
  return value;
}
function withLength<const T extends string[] & { length: number }>(value: T): T {
  return value;
}
function mixed<const T extends string[] | readonly number[]>(value: T): T {
  return value;
}
const optionalResult = optional(['a']);
const intersectionResult = withLength(['b']);
const mixedResult = mixed([3]);
const a: ['a'] = optionalResult;
const b: ['b'] = intersectionResult;
const c: [3] = mixedResult;
const d: ['d'] = ['d'] as const;
console.log(a[0], b[0], c[0], d[0]);
